name: Stacked limestone block wall
in_game: New: a bank kind for newer and higher-end lots (HouseKit, by seed)
real: Cut limestone blocks about 0.6 x 0.6 x 1.2 m in courses, each course stepped back a few cm, joints a few cm, chipped arrises and rough-split faces. Cream when new, greyer with dark lichen above the high water, the silt band below.

course_h.source: 2 ft retaining-wall blocks, typical lakefront construction in North Texas; to confirm against Bean's grey-card photos

budget.note: each block a rounded grid at 6 cm; Nanite. A light copy per block for the 150-600 m band (Track I)
